run_f_gold: run f_gold to count pairs whose product exists in the given array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct pair counting
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a more efficient algorithm than O(n squared)
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses a hash set to count valid product pairs
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that counts pairs with products found in the input array
